name: benchmark_raw
description: A catch-all collection of raw benchmark tasks hosted on Hugging Face that aggregates diverse NLP evaluation items without extensive curation. It is intended for preliminary testing of models across multiple short-form tasks and formats, rather than as a standardized, widely adopted benchmark. Usage and task composition vary by contributor, so quality and labeling consistency can be uneven.
reputation: Low visibility and limited community adoption; primarily used by its creator and a small group for ad-hoc benchmarking and experimentation.
